sources.elevation: Reused V97 Copernicus GLO-30-derived 260×300 numeric grid; retained spacing about 160×230 m
sources.relief: Reused V97 shaded relief (1552×1782), not aerial photography
sources.waterways: Reused V99 OpenStreetMap natural streams; modern geographic guides, not certified historical courses
sources.woodland: V97 ESA WorldCover 2021 proxy, smoothed and artistically reconstructed; not a historical survey
sources.path: Illustrative unpaved pack trail offset from Navisbach; no assertion of an authenticated 1780 alignment
sources.art: Original deterministic material, tree crowns and shading; no external image tiles

rendering: EPSG:4326 inputs; local east/north metric frame at 11.52 E, 47.13 N; elevation metres; no vertical exaggeration
locationNote: Navis valley, northern Brenner region. The actual Brenner Pass summit is about 14 km south and is not this close-up scene.
